title: Recording: Dear Yoko, I’m Losing You by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 22 September 1980.

Lennon recorded his lead vocals for two songs: ‘Dear Yoko’ and ‘I’m Losing You’.

Page last updated: 18 May 2026
